code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    triggered = set()
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i + 1:]:
            dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
            if abs(dr) != abs(dc) or dr == 0:
                continue
            sr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
            sc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
            for k in range(abs(dr) + 1):
                r, c = r1 + k * sr, c1 + k * sc
                if grid[r][c] == 6:
                    triggered.add((r, c, sr, sc))
                elif grid[r][c] == background:
                    out[r][c] = 1
    # A 6 on a 1-line continues along the perpendicular diagonal.
    for r, c, sr, sc in triggered:
        dr, dc = sr, -sc
        rr, cc = r, c
        while 0 <= rr - dr < h and 0 <= cc - dc < w:
            rr -= dr
            cc -= dc
        while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
            out[rr][cc] = 6
            rr += dr
            cc += dc
    return out
'''
